checks.evidence: Source inspection: tests precede component implementation in 642bedb and 486f20a. components/mode-banner.test.tsx:54-81 covers verbatim PRD titles, all G0 statuses and absent G0; lines 120-127 cover mock visibility and exact wording. Implementations match at components/mode-banner.tsx:10-20 and lib/shell.ts:15-27. Test execution is separately NOT_RUN.

checks.criterion: AC2: Shared landmarks, banners, navigation and version footer
checks.evidence: app/layout.tsx:23-38 renders the shared structure around every page. components/mock-banner.tsx:10-14 supplies the conditional red status banner. components/site-footer.tsx:9 displays bundle and schema versions. The claude-r2-1 rebuttal matches the explicit footer wording decision in scripts/ralph/batches/t7-shell/prd.json:179.

checks.criterion: AC3: Exactly the seven requested next/link destinations
checks.evidence: components/site-header.tsx:8-36 defines and renders precisely the seven requested links. The story explicitly permits missing destinations to return 404, supporting the scope rebuttal for claude-r1-2.

checks.criterion: AC4: Keyboard order, visible focus ring and active-route aria-current
checks.evidence: By source inspection, components/site-header.tsx:25-36 renders native links in array order without tabindex overrides, and sets aria-current on exact pathname matches. app/globals.css:67-69 defines the visible focus outline. tests/site-layout.test.tsx:121-154 exercises route selection and anchor attributes.

checks.criterion: AC5: Mode B/C wording and factual home-page content
checks.evidence: components/mode-banner.tsx:10-13 copies PRD 4 titles without stronger claims. app/page.tsx:13-14 contains only the title and factual bundle-record line. The shared layout retains the T0 banner, shipping-mode and footer texts.

checks.criterion: AC6: Build-time bundle loading, static home page and passing smoke check
checks.evidence: The unchanged T0-05 loader is apps/web/lib/bundle.ts:235-241, called from app/layout.tsx:24; app/page.tsx:8 retains dynamic='error'. Static build output and smoke success require execution, prohibited by the read-only review instruction.

checks.criterion: AC7: Preserve exact protected-text assertions while narrowing equality to main
checks.evidence: scripts/page-check.ts:119 selects blocks by their own text, excluding nested blocks. An exact-text child paragraph can therefore satisfy the check while its enclosing status banner contains extra words. The original codex-r1-1 prefix cases and codex-r2-1 span cases are addressed, but full-container validation remains incomplete. Main equality is present at lines 165-175; the production guard in lib/bundle.ts is unchanged.

checks.criterion: AC8: Only site-header is client-side; static output and initial-JS budget
checks.evidence: Source inspection confirms components/site-header.tsx:1 is the sole application client directive and imports only next/link and next/navigation. Story notes record 177,190 B versus the 173,974 B baseline, but the gzip measurement and generated client manifest were not independently checked. The claude-r1-1 and claude-r2-2 measurement rebuttals therefore remain unverified in this review.

findings.claim: Validate the complete banner container when its marker occupies a nested block. Criterion 7 and codex-r2-1 remain partially unresolved.
findings.evidence:
By inspection, replace MOCK_PAGE's mock paragraph with '

Mock bundle — placeholder data, not results

yet
'. The inner p has the exact expected own/full text; the enclosing status div has own text 'yet', so line 119 excludes it. bannerProblem returns null and the unchanged mode, main and footer checks also accept the fixture, despite the status banner containing additional words. Tests at tests/page-check.test.ts:123-172 cover nested suffixes but never place the expected marker inside a child block. Preserve the banner container's identity and compare its full text, with a regression case for this valid nested markup.
